Arc Pendant Light

The Arc Pendant embodies the quiet elegance of Scandinavian design. Each piece is hand-bent by our workshop artisans, creating subtle variations that make every light unique. The natural linen shade diffuses light softly, casting a warm glow that transforms any space into a sanctuary.
